profile.description: Biofarm S.A. manufactures pharmaceutical products. The company's products include cardiovascular, digestive and metabolic, genito-urinary, ophthalmological, endocrine, nervous system, osteo-muscular, respiratory and ENT, multivitamin, antiallergen, and dermatological products. Biofarm S.A. was founded in 1921 and is based in Bucharest, Romania. As of June 24, 2026, Biofarm S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Polpharma SA Pharmaceutical Works.
